include.description: Part files merged into this document (`parts/fin_can.rw.toml`).

variants.description: Named param sets: variant → param → value.

stage.description: `[stage.<id>]`: stages by their first body component.

description:
`rocket.rw.toml` (also `parts/*.rw.toml`): params, components, materials,
asserts, and report values.
title: RocketDoc

ParamValue.description: A param value: a number, a bool, or a string (`"140 mm"`, `"= expr"`, or a choice).

first.description: First body component of the stage.

override.description:
Mass and CG override of the whole stage (`subtree = true`: a stage
owns no mass of its own). CG is measured from the stage's fore end.

cg.description: CG measured from this component's fore end.

subtree.description: `true`: the override replaces the whole subtree's values.

name.description: Display name; defaults to the id.

attach.description: Placement relative to a parent anchor. Absent only on the first body component.

override.description: Mass, CG, and CD overrides (flagged in the check report).

cut.description: `true`: this component subtracts material from its parent (BOSL2 `diff()`).

import.description: Import provenance (`.ork` UUID), kept for event mapping.

Component.description: One `[c.<id>]` table. Common fields first; the `type` key selects the kind.

at.description: Own anchor that lands on `to`; default is the mirrored anchor.

Finish.description: Surface finish: a named preset or an explicit roughness.

Appearance.description: Renderer appearance (R2.5). Presets map to PBR materials.

capped.description: Closed end (bulkhead) at the shoulder's free end.

Shoulder.description: A shoulder on a nose cone or transition.

shape_param.description: Power exponent, Haack C, or parabolic K (shape-dependent).

offset.description: Offset of the tab's fore edge from the root leading edge, +aft.

FinTab.description: A fin tab through the body wall.

sweep.description: Leading-edge sweep length (root LE to tip LE, axial).

points.description: Planform `[x, y]` points from the root LE (x +aft, y outward), root first and last on y = 0.

motor_mount.description: Accepts a motor (configs assign one by this component's id).

overhang.description: Motor overhang past the aft end.

od.description: Defaults to the parent's inner diameter.
Outer diameter of the base and the flange.

height.description: Total height above the body surface.

base_height.description: Height of the base at the body surface (default `height / 4`).

flange_height.description: Height of the flange at the outer face (default `height / 4`).

line_material.description: Shroud-line material (needs a `line_density`); the canopy uses `material`.

fraction.description: Fill as a fraction of internal volume, or give `volume`.

Tank.description: A propellant tank (inner component) used by liquid engines (R2.5, R2.7).

yield_strength.description: Yield strength (tank hoop-stress check, liquid engines).

Material.description: A material in `[materials.<name>]` (bulk, surface, or line density).

expr.description: Expression over metric paths, e.g. `stability.liftoff >= 1.0 cal`.
